run_parlaiformat_teacher: run the ParlaiformatTeacher to load and serve data from a ParlAI Text Dialog format file
run_fbformat_teacher: run the FbformatTeacher to load dialog data from a specified file path for quick testing
run_fbformat2_teacher: run the Fbformat2Teacher to load a second dialog data file for multi-task testing
run_parlaiformat2_teacher: run the Parlaiformat2Teacher to load an additional ParlAI format data file via fromfile_datapath2
run_default_teacher: run the DefaultTeacher which extends ParlaiformatTeacher to load ParlAI dialog data from a file
